data: Was the model trained for the same number of epochs on the full dataset as for 10% of the data?

The x-axis represents training time in epochs. The left graph shows training time up to 20 epochs, while the right graph shows training time up to 100 epochs. This indicates that the model trained on the full dataset was trained for fewer epochs than the model trained on 10% of the dataset. Therefore, the answer is no.
